message: The schema components.schemas.NotFoundErrorBody is named "NotFoundErrorBody", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.NotFoundError (renamed with a "Body" suffix because "NotFoundError" is a Fern error name) at #/components/schemas/NotFoundError. Both become Fern types named "NotFoundErrorBody" in the same file, so Fern keeps only one of them and silently drops the other; references to the dropped schema point to the one Fern keeps. Rename one of them with x-fern-type-name.
